method.interval_semantics: Ordinal planning intervals and explicit baseline judgments, not estimated confidence intervals, observed beneficiaries, causal effects, uptake forecasts, or fractions mechanically applied to populations.
method.scope_rule: Only current first package with its own entry/prerequisite/accessibility work. Future packages cannot inflate the first-output R.
method.non_overlap: R is net of literacy/entry feasibility, academic-language comfort and existing usable editions. N is descriptive evidence about that residual and must not be applied again as an invented multiplicative discount.
method.no_experimental_requirement: Plausible literature-backed inferences are allowed. Unknown remains unknown only where the inspected sources do not support any defensible magnitude; no human review or experiment is a construction/publication prerequisite.
method.missing_joint_data: Threshold percentages are arithmetic requirements for a band, not measured or assumed population fractions. Narrowing scope to currently enrolled pupils alone would incorrectly erase self-directed adults, but those adults cannot be silently counted either.
